subject: Copy of last invoice
body: Hello, could you please send me a copy of our invoice for last month? Our accounting team needs it for the quarterly close. Thank you.
answer: Thank you for reaching out. You can download all invoices from Settings > Billing > Invoices. If you cannot access this page, please let us know and we will email the invoice to the billing contact.

subject: Charged twice this month
body: Hi, our credit card was charged twice for the March subscription fee. Can you check and fix this?
answer: Thank you for letting us know. We are reviewing the duplicate charge on your account. If it is confirmed, the extra payment will be refunded to the original card within 5 to 10 business days.

subject: VAT number on invoices
body: Hello, we would like our VAT number to appear on future invoices. Where can we add it?
answer: You can add your VAT number in Settings > Billing > Company details. It will appear on every invoice issued after the change.

subject: Switch to annual billing
body: We are currently billed monthly on the Pro plan and would like to switch to annual billing. How does the price change?
answer: You can switch to annual billing in Settings > Billing > Plan. The remaining value of your current month is credited, and annual billing applies the discount shown on the pricing page.

subject: Payment failed, account locked
body: Urgent: our payment failed and now the whole team cannot access the workspace. We need access restored immediately.
answer: We are sorry for the disruption. A failed payment puts the workspace in read-only mode after the grace period. Please update the card in Settings > Billing; access is restored as soon as the payment succeeds. A specialist is also reviewing your account.

subject: Refund request after cancellation
body: Hello, we cancelled our subscription two days after renewal. Are we eligible for a refund?
answer: Thank you for your message. Refund eligibility depends on your plan and the date of cancellation. A member of our billing team will review your request and get back to you.

subject: API returns 500 errors
body: Since this morning every call to the projects API returns HTTP 500. Our integration is completely blocked. Please investigate urgently.
answer: Thank you for the report. We are investigating the 500 errors on the projects API with our engineering team and will update you as soon as we know more. Please share a request id if you have one.

subject: Webhook not triggering
body: Our webhook for task updates stopped firing yesterday. The endpoint is reachable and returns 200. What could be wrong?
answer: Please check in Settings > Integrations > Webhooks that the webhook is still active; webhooks are disabled automatically after repeated delivery failures. You can re-enable it and send a test event from the same page.

subject: Rate limit exceeded
body: We keep getting 429 Too Many Requests from the API when syncing our data. What are the limits?
answer: The API allows a fixed number of requests per minute per workspace, depending on your plan. When you receive a 429, wait for the time given in the Retry-After header before retrying. Batch endpoints help reduce the number of calls.

subject: API token rotation
body: How can we rotate our API tokens without downtime?
answer: Create a new token in Settings > API, update your integration to use it, then revoke the old token. Both tokens work in parallel until you revoke the old one.

subject: CSV export fails
body: When I export a large project to CSV the download fails with a timeout error.
answer: Large exports are generated in the background. Please use Export > Send by email; you will receive a download link when the file is ready.

subject: Data sync with CRM broken
body: The integration with our CRM stopped syncing deals and our sales team is blocked. This is critical for us.
answer: We understand the urgency. Our technical team is looking into the CRM integration. In the meantime, please try disconnecting and reconnecting the integration in Settings > Integrations, and share any error message you see.

subject: How to create a project template
body: Hello, how do I save a project as a template so my team can reuse it?
answer: Open the project, click the menu in the top right corner and choose Save as template. The template will then be available to everyone in your workspace when they create a new project.

subject: Dashboard numbers look wrong
body: The time tracking dashboard shows different totals than the report export. Which one is correct?
answer: The dashboard uses your workspace time zone, while exports use UTC by default. You can change the export time zone in the export settings so that both match.

subject: Custom fields on tasks
body: Is it possible to add custom fields to tasks, for example a cost center?
answer: Yes. Custom fields are available on the Pro and Enterprise plans. Go to Project settings > Fields to add text, number, date or dropdown fields.

subject: Gantt view for clients
body: Can we share a read-only Gantt view with an external client?
answer: You can share a read-only link to any project view from Share > Public link. The link can be protected with a password and revoked at any time.

subject: Dark mode
body: Feature suggestion: please add a dark mode to the web app.
answer: Thank you for the suggestion. We have shared it with our product team.

subject: Change account owner
body: Our account owner left the company. How can we transfer ownership to me?
answer: An admin can transfer ownership in Settings > Members. If no admin is available, please reply from your company email and our team will verify the request.

subject: Add more seats
body: We hired five new people. How do we add seats to our subscription?
answer: Admins can add seats in Settings > Billing > Seats. New seats are billed pro rata for the current period.

subject: Training session
body: Do you offer onboarding sessions for new teams?
answer: Yes. We offer free onboarding webinars every week and dedicated sessions for Enterprise customers. You can register from the Help menu.

subject: Cannot invite users
body: When I invite a colleague the invitation email never arrives.
answer: Please ask your colleague to check their spam folder and make sure emails from our domain are allowed. You can also resend the invitation from Settings > Members.

subject: SSO login broken for all users
body: Since this morning nobody in our company can log in with SSO. We get a SAML error. All users are blocked.
answer: We are sorry for the trouble. A SAML error for all users is often caused by an expired identity provider certificate. Please check the certificate in your SSO settings. Our team is also looking into it with priority.

subject: Configure SAML with Okta
body: We want to set up SAML single sign-on with Okta. Is there a guide?
answer: Yes. SSO is available on the Enterprise plan. Follow the guide in Settings > Security > SSO: copy the ACS URL and entity id into Okta, then upload the Okta metadata file.

subject: IP allowlist
body: Can we restrict access to our workspace to our office IP addresses?
answer: IP allowlisting is available on the Enterprise plan in Settings > Security > Network. Add your ranges in CIDR notation.

subject: SCIM provisioning
body: Do you support SCIM for user provisioning from Azure AD?
answer: Yes, SCIM 2.0 provisioning is supported on the Enterprise plan. Generate a SCIM token in Settings > Security and use it in your Azure AD enterprise application.

subject: Firewall blocks websocket
body: Our corporate proxy seems to block real-time updates in the app.
answer: Real-time updates use websockets. Please allow websocket connections to our domain in your proxy or firewall configuration.

subject: Application down
body: The application is down for our whole team, we only get a 503 page. Is there an outage?
answer: Thank you for reporting this. We are checking the status of the service. Please follow our status page for real-time updates; we will notify you as soon as the issue is resolved.

subject: Planned maintenance window
body: When is the next planned maintenance and will there be downtime?
answer: Planned maintenance is announced at least 72 hours in advance on our status page and by email to admins. Most maintenance happens without downtime.

subject: Very slow and timing out
body: Everything is extremely slow and pages time out. This is affecting all users in our company.
answer: We are sorry for the slowness. Our engineers are investigating performance issues. Please check the status page for updates and send us your workspace name so we can look at your account specifically.

subject: Subscribe to status updates
body: How can I get notified about incidents?
answer: You can subscribe to incident notifications by email or RSS on our status page.

subject: Data center location
body: Where is our data stored? We are based in the EU.
answer: Customer data for EU workspaces is hosted in data centers located in the European Union. More details are available in our security documentation.

subject: GDPR data processing agreement
body: Can you send us your data processing agreement?
answer: Our data processing agreement is available in Settings > Legal, where an admin can review and sign it online.

subject: Delete our account data
body: We are leaving and want all our data deleted. How do we proceed?
answer: An admin can request account deletion in Settings > Workspace > Delete workspace. Data is deleted permanently after 30 days. We recommend exporting your data first.

subject: Return a damaged product
body: I received a damaged item and would like to return it for a replacement.
answer: Thank you for contacting us. Please send us your order number and a photo of the damaged item so we can arrange a replacement.

subject: Quote for 200 users
body: We are evaluating your platform for 200 users. Can we get a quote and a demo?
answer: Thank you for your interest. Our sales team will contact you to schedule a demo and prepare a quote.

subject: Job application
body: I would like to apply for a job at your company. Where should I send my CV?
answer: Thank you for your interest. Please visit our careers page to see open positions and apply online.

subject: Mobile app crashes
body: The mobile app crashes every time I open a project with attachments.
answer: Please update the app to the latest version. If the crash continues, send us your device model and app version so our team can reproduce the issue.

subject: API pagination
body: How does pagination work in the tasks API?
answer: The tasks API uses cursor-based pagination. Pass the next_cursor value from the previous response to get the next page.

subject: Accepted payment methods
body: Which payment methods do you accept for annual plans?
answer: Annual plans can be paid by credit card or bank transfer. Bank transfer is available for invoices above a minimum amount.

subject: Downgrade our plan
body: We would like to downgrade from Enterprise to Pro at renewal.
answer: You can schedule a downgrade in Settings > Billing > Plan. The change takes effect at your next renewal date; Enterprise-only features will be disabled then.

subject: Notifications too frequent
body: Our team gets too many email notifications. How can we reduce them?
answer: Each user can choose which notifications to receive in Profile > Notifications. Admins can also set workspace defaults.

subject: Suspicious login attempts
body: We see many failed login attempts on admin accounts. Could this be a security incident?
answer: Thank you for alerting us. Our security team will review the login activity on your workspace. We recommend enforcing two-factor authentication for all admins in Settings > Security.

subject: Uptime SLA
body: What uptime do you guarantee?
answer: Our uptime commitment is described in the service level agreement for your plan, available in our legal documentation.

subject: Invoice shows wrong company name
body: The company name on our invoices is wrong. Can you correct it?
answer: You can update the company name in Settings > Billing > Company details. Future invoices will use the new name; we can reissue past invoices on request.

subject: Integration with Slack not posting
body: The Slack integration stopped posting task updates to our channel.
answer: Please reconnect the Slack integration in Settings > Integrations > Slack and make sure the app is still invited to the channel.

subject: Language of the interface
body: Can we use the app in German?
answer: Yes. Each user can choose the interface language in Profile > Preferences.

subject: Recurring tasks
body: Can tasks repeat automatically every week?
answer: Yes. Open the task, click the due date and choose a repeat rule such as weekly or monthly.

subject: Emails delayed
body: Notification emails arrive with several hours of delay today.
answer: We are aware of delays with some email notifications and are working with our email provider. Please check the status page for updates.
